name: Keep Ovarian Cancer
remarks: Keeps only patients who received an ovarian cancer diagnosis, so a run
produces a pure ovarian cohort while every other module still runs and
gives each kept patient a full comorbidity history.
Tests the attribute rather than the SNOMED condition. ovarian_cancer.json
sets 'Ovarian Cancer' via assign_to_attribute on Diagnose_Ovarian_Cancer and
never ends the condition, so the attribute and an Active Condition check
agree today -- but the attribute keeps agreeing if the module later gains a
ConditionEnd for remission, where an Active Condition check would start
Yield: roughly 1 in 74 female lifetimes reach a diagnosis (0.3% BRCA
carriers at ~42% lifetime risk, 1.2% family history at ~3.4%, 98.5% average
risk at ~1.2%), so pair this with -g F. Every rejected patient is a full
lifetime simulation, so budget ~74 simulated lives per patient exported.
